properties.decision:
@ajs, 2026-10-22: "I feel like with each mathmatical proof we run and philosophical arguments (lines of reasoning), that we refine/fine-tune reflow2 processes (and other associated flo2 MCPs) - maybe we can do a few more of these test cases", then "Go with your recommendations, all three in that order".

THREE MORE TRIALS, IN ORDER:
1. THE FOUR COLOUR THEOREM, THROUGH ITS HISTORY.
   - The history: Kempe's 1879 proof was accepted for about 11 years until Heawood found the broken step (1890). Heawood saved the five colour theorem from it. Appel and Haken then proved the full theorem by a computer-checked case analysis (1976), and Gonthier machine-checked it in Coq (2005).
   - What it tests:
     - one wrong step is pinpointed, and exactly what rests on it falls;
     - the five colour theorem stands while the four colour claim falls back to open, between 1890 and 1976;
     - what kind of support a computer case analysis is;
     - the bridge "the Coq statement models the theorem" (dec:idea-a-bridge-premise-says-a-formal-statement-models-a-claim), this time where it is settled rather than disputed as on Navier–Stokes;
     - a claim accepted for a time and later withdrawn (the "claimed" reading the NS map found missing).
2. THE ROCKET EQUATION, DERIVED, WITH REAL NUMBERS.
   - The simplifying assumptions (no gravity, no drag, constant exhaust speed) are premises, so dropping "no gravity" shows what falls.
   - Units are checked through the derivation, which no proof trial has used.
   - flo2-calc works a real vehicle's numbers as evidence: it exercises calc far harder than the Riemann check.
3. GETTIER AGAINST "KNOWLEDGE IS JUSTIFIED TRUE BELIEF".
   - A definition knocked down by counterexamples, then a chain of repairs, each with its own counterexample. No earlier trial argued about a definition.
   - The dispute is still open among philosophers, so it must read open on purpose, not unfinished.

CONSIDERED, NOT CHOSEN NOW: Zeno's Achilles answered by convergent series (maths answering philosophy); the ether and Michelson–Morley (a hypothesis tested and abandoned).

HOW THEY RUN:
- One trial at a time, alongside the build PRs, within ≤2 agents: one slot for a build PR, one for a trial. Four colour runs alongside PR A.
- Each is the three-agent pattern (owner, designer, observer). The observer checks every citation against its source first and gives FULL sha256 values in the source packet, so the designer can pin sources (the NS map packet gave prefixes only).
- Findings feed the open PRs. After PR A ships, re-run one earlier rung as a regression check that the fixes changed the readings.
properties.name: The proof ladder goes on past Navier–Stokes with three trials, each aimed at a known gap: the four colour theorem, then the rocket equation, then Gettier
properties.rationale: Each trial so far has turned up what no unit test did (the NS map: no "claimed" reading, a shared premise the independence check misses, a not-read source counting as citing). These three are chosen to aim at the gaps not yet exercised: a withdrawn claim and a computer proof, units and calc, and a contested definition.
